title: Access and use iClicker
issue: You need to access or request iClicker
resolution_html:
1. Confirm that your instructor is using iClicker in your course
  2. Follow the course-specific device or app registration directions
  3. Join the assigned course activity and confirm participation is recorded
  4. Contact Learning Technology Services for a registration or connection problem

For an access problem, contact askIT with the service name and relevant error
